# SuperRare Exploit Post-Mortem: How Olympix Would Have Prevented the $730K Loss

‍Date of Incident: July 28, 2024
Amount Lost: $730,000 (11,907,875 RARE tokens)
Exploited Contract: 0xffb512b9176d527c5d32189c3e310ed4ab2bb9ec (RareStakingV1)
Transaction Hash: 0xd813751bfb98a51912b8394b5856ae4515be6a9c6e5583e06b41d9255ba6e3c1

## Executive Summary

The SuperRare NFT platform suffered a $730,000 exploit due to a critical access control vulnerability in its staking contract. The vulnerability was caused by inverted logic in the updateMerkleRoot() function, which allowed any address to modify the Merkle root instead of restricting access to authorized addresses only. This exploit represents a textbook case where mutation testing could have prevented the incident entirely.

A single transaction. A single block. A flash loan and 1 wei of collateral in, nearly $9.6 million out. No compromised keys, no governance attack — just protocol logic executing exactly as designed, in a way the system never accounted for.

What Is Resupply Protocol?

Resupply is a stablecoin lending protocol where users deposit collateral and borrow reUSD against it. Instead of using plain tokens as collateral, the protocol accepts ERC-4626 vault shares—tokenized representations of assets deposited into yield-generating vaults.

At a high level, the flow looks like this:

The exploited market was the crvUSD-wstUSR pair. In this market, users could deposit shares of a newly deployed ERC-4626 vault called cvcrvUSD as collateral and borrow reUSD against them.

## Conclusion

This bug stems from improper token validation and unsafe reuse of transient storage without clearing it. By carefully crafting the return value, we can reenter the contract and repeatedly bypass the expected checks, ultimately minting an unlimited amount of USDS stablecoins.

## 2.3.3. 真实案例：Resupply 攻击

2025 年 6 月 26 日，Curve 生态中的稳定币协议 Resupply 在以太坊主网上部署的智能合约遭受攻击，损失约 1000 万美元的加密资产。攻击者利用 Resupply 的价格预言机设计缺陷，针对新创建的低流动性市场实施了捐赠攻击（Donation Attack）。通过操纵 Resupply 发行的稳定币 reUSD 的相对价格，使其价格归零，攻击者得以绕过市场仓位的资产健康度检查，借出大量 reUSD 并从中获利。
